text: {"assertions":["A signature mismatch bug was found in crypto/keys/rotation.py when rotating the signing key while requests are in flight.","The bug manifested as verification failures against the previous key and was discovered during a rolling restart of the fleet.","The root cause was an N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation in the database code.","The fix involved prefetching the relation in a single query via PR #4269 on branch fix/signature-mismatch-1.","The fix resulted in reclaiming 45 GB of blob storage.","The codebase is written in Python and is covered by tests in tests/crypto/test_rotation.py."]}
